decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service option close to the core business and was still shown in 2024, so its value is not yet resolved and carrying it costs little.
The seventy-two-hour express program needs more operational effort, but it was still on the website in 2024, so the option on fast-delivery demand remains worth holding while uncertainty lasts.
This multi-model express line kept its own page in both years, which signals continued commitment and an option still developing.
